notes: A CORRECTION, NOT A NEW ADJUDICATION. Applies the main() argc/argv ruling (Brandon, 2026-09-24; bmdb 1548) to every API00-C row keyed on a main() definition that is not a task-644-full-reaudit row (those are left for bmdb 1541, which is rewriting them) and not already under the ruling (the four bmdb 1541 hostap corrections and the lua.c:777 correction). Ruling: API00-C on main()'s argv parameter itself is FP by C11 5.1.2.2.1 (argv[argc] is a null pointer, so argv points to at least one element); a finding about argv[i] indexed without an argc bound is TP; argc is judged like any other integer parameter. Scope: 35 API00-C rows across all projects are keyed on a main() definition line (read at each row's pinned commit); 9 are task-644-full-reaudit rows (skipped), 5 are already under the ruling (4 bmdb 1541 hostap corrections and the lua.c:777 correction), and 21 were re-derived here. Every one of the 21 names argv. RESULT: 11 flips TP -> FP, where argv is indexed only under an argc bound or only passed on (curl 1, hostap 1, mosquitto 1, pureftpd 8); 1 TP stands with its reason restated (ventoy VentoyJson.c:719, argv[1] with no argc check); the 9 standing FP rows are unchanged and not part of this batch. Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision claim is made here.
